task.description: Independently validate TEST-DESIGNER's ISS-0343 test spec and test code. Per-criterion coverage check, no @tag :skip / TODO, fixture isolation/self-sufficiency, no hardcoded secrets. This is a WF-03 regression test that is NOT a 'code did not exist' case (register_type/2, get_type/2, Backfill.run/1 all pre-existed the fix), so the mandatory check is: confirm the spec states, and independently reproduce myself in my own throwaway git worktree at the pre-fix commit (4d20542^ = 54a0c14) with a dedicated MIX_TEST_PARTITION/test DB, that the new tests actually fail pre-fix with the exact defect shape, then pass at HEAD. Mutant-isolation procedure does not apply here (only required when pre-fix failure is UndefinedFunctionError because the module itself didn't exist).
acceptance_criteria: test/specs/ISS-0343.md covers: defect recap, fix summary, why tests are deterministic not race-timing-dependent, fail-then-pass proof, test case table
every acceptance-criterion-bearing behavior (get_type/2 tolerance, register_type/2 tolerance, Backfill.run/1 skip-not-crash) has a runnable, non-skipped test
no @tag :skip on a MUST-covering test, no 'TODO: implement test' left in the spec
test fixtures self-sufficient (no dependency on shared hardcoded state or execution order), no hardcoded secrets/connection strings
independently reproduce fail-then-pass in own throwaway git worktree + dedicated test DB, quote own output, clean up worktree and DB afterward

result.summary:
All acceptance criteria covered by runnable tests; no gaps found.

Coverage check: test/specs/ISS-0343.md (read in full) contains all five required sections (defect recap referencing step-01's diagnosis, fix summary matching the actual registry.ex/backfill.ex diff, a 'why deterministic' section correctly explaining the tests reproduce the race's END-STATE rather than its timing, the fail-then-pass proof, and a 5-row test-case table). test/letflow/event_store/registry_tenant_schema_missing_test.exs (read in full, 169 lines) has 3 tests: get_type/2 tolerance, register_type/2 tolerance, and a control test proving the fix doesn't change healthy-tenant behavior. test/letflow/tenant_provisioning/backfill_test.exs (read in full) has one new test appended (ISS-0343 section) covering Backfill.run/1's new case clause, plus the 3 pre-existing ISS-0332 tests untouched. Grepped both test files and the spec for '@tag :skip' and 'TODO: implement test': zero matches. Fixtures (tenant_with_vanished_schema/1 and its backfill_test.exs twin) each provision their own tenant via unique_slug, register their own on_exit cleanup, and do not read any state left by another test or depend on test execution order -- self-sufficient. No hardcoded secrets: the only credential-shaped string in scope is config/test.exs's existing local dev DB password ('letflow'), pre-existing project config, not something these test files introduced. Verified diff of the actual fix (git show 4d20542 -- lib/letflow/event_store/registry.ex lib/letflow/tenant_provisioning/backfill.ex) matches what the spec and tests describe: rescue_missing_schema/1 rescues only %Postgrex.Error{postgres: %{code: :undefined_table}}, re-raises everything else; Backfill.run/1 gains one new case clause for {:error, :tenant_schema_missing} mirroring the existing :tenant_not_provisioned handling.

Not a 'code did not exist' case: register_type/2, get_type/2, and Backfill.run/1 all pre-date this fix (confirmed via git show 4d20542^:lib/letflow/event_store/registry.ex still defining these functions, just without the rescue wrapping) -- so per WF-03's rule, the mutant-isolation fallback procedure does not apply here; a direct pre-fix-vs-post-fix worktree run is the correct and sufficient proof.

Independently reproduced the fail-then-pass proof myself, in my own throwaway git worktree, with my own dedicated test DB partition (MIX_TEST_PARTITION=99, distinct from TEST-DESIGNER's own MIX_TEST_PARTITION=98, so the two runs could not collide):

1. `git worktree add <scratchpad>/iss0343-validator-prefix 4d20542^` -> landed at 54a0c14 (confirmed: `git log -1 --oneline 4d20542^` = 54a0c14, matches the commit TEST-DESIGNER's spec names).
2. `grep -n tenant_schema_missing lib/letflow/event_store/registry.ex lib/letflow/tenant_provisioning/backfill.ex` in the worktree -> exit 1, zero matches: confirmed the pre-fix code genuinely lacks the tolerance logic.
3. Symlinked deps/ from the main checkout, copied both new/modified test files into the worktree unchanged, ran `MIX_ENV=test mix compile` -> compiled the letflow app cleanly (135 files) against pre-fix lib/.
4. Created a dedicated throwaway test DB: `MIX_ENV=test MIX_TEST_PARTITION=99 mix ecto.create && mix ecto.migrate` -> both succeeded.
5. Pre-fix run: `MIX_ENV=test MIX_TEST_PARTITION=99 mix test test/letflow/event_store/registry_tenant_schema_missing_test.exs test/letflow/tenant_provisioning/backfill_test.exs` -> 'Finished in 6.1 seconds ... Result: 5/8 passed, Failed: 3 tests'. All 3 failures are the exact ones TEST-DESIGNER's spec names: (a) get_type/2 test -> `** (Postgrex.Error) ERROR 42P01 (undefined_table) relation "tenant_2c181643c65a4c3b98d5a0afd5119719.event_type_registry" does not exist`, raised straight out of `Registry.get_type/2`, no rescue; (b) register_type/2 test -> same undefined_table error, raised out of `Registry.register_type(valid_attrs(), tenant_id)`; (c) the new Backfill.run/1 test -> same undefined_table error at `lib/letflow/event_store/registry.ex:233: Letflow.EventStore.Registry.insert_with_monotonicity_check/2` propagating through `lib/letflow/tenant_provisioning/backfill.ex:26: anonymous fn/3 in Letflow.TenantProvisioning.Backfill.run/1` and `Enum.reduce_while/3`, crashing the whole `Backfill.run(v2_attrs())` call -- exactly the 'one tenant's vanished schema crashes the entire sweep' defect. The other 5 tests (3 pre-existing ISS-0332 BackfillTest tests + the new file's control test, which never drops a schema) passed unchanged. This exactly matches TEST-DESIGNER's own reported 5/8-passed, 3-failures-at-the-same-3-call-sites result -- independently reproduced, not copied.
6. Cleaned up: `MIX_ENV=test MIX_TEST_PARTITION=99 mix ecto.drop` -> 'The database for Letflow.Repo has been dropped'; `git worktree remove --force <scratchpad>/iss0343-validator-prefix`; `git worktree list` afterward shows only the main checkout -- confirmed removed.
7. Post-fix run on this branch at HEAD (main checkout, no worktree): `MIX_ENV=test mix test test/letflow/event_store/registry_tenant_schema_missing_test.exs test/letflow/tenant_provisioning/backfill_test.exs test/letflow/event_store/registry_test.exs` -> 'Finished in 24.2 seconds (0.00s async, 24.2s sync), Result: 36 passed'. All 3 previously-failing tests now pass; no regression in the 33 pre-existing RegistryTest/BackfillTest tests.
8. `mix format --check-formatted` on both test files -> exit 0 (clean).
9. `git status --porcelain lib/ test/` -> empty (no leftover mutant/probe artifacts; nothing was mutated in this validation since the pre-fix reproduction used pre-fix code as-is, not a mutant of the shipped fix).
